bullets.text: Chennai recorded 10.5cm of rain, flooding parts of north Chennai and Velachery and exposing flood preparedness gaps, so the office should monitor relief efforts.
Two school students tragically drowned in the Puzhal lake in Ambattur after a 15-hour search, and the office should watch safety measures around water bodies.
Heavy rain is forecasted across ten districts including Chennai and Thiruvallur, so the district team should maintain high alert for waterlogging.
Tender announcements were issued for clearing the Cooum, Adyar, and Buckingham canals to improve the environment, and the office should track project progress.
Anbumani Ramadoss urged Chief Minister Vijay to notify the Pallikaranai marshland and release a management plan, which the constituency team should review.
The delayed Adyar food court highlights execution challenges for the Greater Chennai Corporation, and the office should monitor urban infrastructure delivery.
Transgender individuals demonstrated at the SIPCOT industrial park in Gummidipoondi, causing employees to close gates, and the district team should watch industrial relations.
A seven-month-old child tragically died from a fever in Thiruvallur, and the office should monitor public health responses and dengue or fever outbreaks.
Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong and Chief Minister Vijay opened CapitaLand's first Chennai data centre, and the portfolio team should support tech investments.
Equinix India plans to expand its data centre capacity to 70 MW driven by AI, and the office should track digital infrastructure growth across the state.
MeitY asked Meta to review content recommendations amid public order concerns in Delhi, and the portfolio team should monitor regulatory developments.
